decision_rule: robust research win iff extended Native pooled StQ2 delta < 0 AND normal-placement ASLR-on paired 95% CI below zero; reversed ASLR-on reported and flagged (not failed) if it disagrees

methodology.aslr: on only (randomize_va_space=2); no ASLR-off setting, no setarch -R
methodology.native: fixed single-entry okc-amd64 (compiler wrapper sha256 3314c5712c267e0f50f7a3b7fd3738721562cb1d6c78fbdfb06feae97b76c1a6); not the default selection, unmodified measure.c, one 9-launch batch per role per round, round order rotate, pooled per role; independent pools, not paired
methodology.paired: O3GC fixed ELFs, ABBA/BAAB blocks, ASLR on; normal placement primary, reversed placement secondary robustness check
references: SUPERCOP: normal compile/link, many fresh processes, StQ
mlkem-native: single process, warm-ups, median; no placement/ASLR control
